demo_cards.title: Best stable release case (noop baseline)
demo_cards.what_changed: No compression; full-KV greedy reference with 100% draft acceptance.
demo_cards.why_it_matters: Establishes the exactness baseline on the 1500-cell public panel.
demo_cards.public_safe_claim: noop achieves acceptance_rate=1.0 with exactkv_failures=0 on tested cells.
demo_cards.caveat: Panel-scoped greedy decoding; not serving throughput.

demo_cards.title: Strong INT8 release case
demo_cards.what_changed: INT8 stored KV compression with verifier-backed draft acceptance.
demo_cards.why_it_matters: Shows int8 can remain exactness-compatible on many prompts in the public panel.
demo_cards.public_safe_claim: int8 achieves acceptance_rate=1.0 with exactkv_failures=0 on cited Llama cells.
demo_cards.caveat: Compression ratio is stored tensor byte ratio; not active GPU memory savings.

demo_cards.title: INT4 drift / compression-break case
demo_cards.what_changed: Lower acceptance (0.5) under int4_sim on p01_p1_simple_math.
demo_cards.why_it_matters: Demonstrates when compressed KV paths diverge before full exactness recovery.
demo_cards.public_safe_claim: int4_sim shows reduced acceptance_rate=0.5 while exactkv_failures remain 0.
demo_cards.caveat: Simulated int4 container; illustrates drift metrics, not deployment speedups.

demo_cards.title: Shard probe-first case
demo_cards.why_it_matters: Shows bounded probe analysis for shard-style compression hypotheses.
demo_cards.public_safe_claim: Shard slot is probe-first heuristic analysis, not full Shard product integration.
demo_cards.caveat: probe_only=True; not real Shard / ShardCache integration.

demo_cards.title: SpectralQuant fallback/proxy case
demo_cards.why_it_matters: Documents adapter honesty when the real dependency is unavailable.
demo_cards.public_safe_claim: SpectralQuant results use fallback/proxy in the current environment.
demo_cards.caveat: spectralquant_available=False; do not claim real SpectralQuant integration.

demo_cards.title: Historical structured-output JSON drift demo
demo_cards.what_changed: Pharmacy-style intent-flip prompt is not in the Phase A panel; p2_json_tool is the closest in-panel structured-output drift case.
demo_cards.why_it_matters: Illustrates token-level drift and verifier-mediated exactness on a historical demo panel.
demo_cards.public_safe_claim: Illustrative exactness evidence from pre-release demo artifacts; not the 1500-cell public headline.
demo_cards.caveat: Historical/internal panel; not throughput or serving evidence.
